session_summary: Shipped two changes as v0.1.3 (npm-published, tag v0.1.3, branch feat/glimpse-implementation): (1) the Tier-2->Tier-3 inferred dispatch-visibility feature (8-task T1-T8: log-inference parser -> reconciler synth child -> lifecycle triggers -> subdispatch edge -> ghosted frontend + fan-out cap; commit 215fb9c), and (2) a step-output parser fix where RE_STEP_EMBED/RE_DONE_EMBED dropped the description for token-only-wrapped markers like `[STEP 2]` text (commit c627bbe). Diagnosis via code-analyst, design via project-planner, implementation via fullstack-dev/ui-designer/fixture-writer, commits/release via committer/config-editor/branch-manager. Final suite 162/162.

agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Given a task to extract a fixture from large real logs, it spent all 15 turns searching/correlating lines and never wrote the file (max_turns failure). Correlating tool_use/tool_result pairs across a big stream-JSON log is too expensive for a micro-agent's budget.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: fixture-writer should, when a source is large, write a small extraction script and run it rather than hand-searching; or dispatchers should pre-extract. Recovered here by handing file-patch-runner a pre-verified extraction script.

agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Hit max_turns during its FINAL validation grep after all edits had landed -> false-failure exit 1. Same pattern seen earlier with committer.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: For multi-edit frontend tasks, do all post-edit validation in ONE combined command, and treat 'all edits applied + node --check passes' as success even if the turn budget ends mid-verification. A cheap verify-repair re-dispatch confirmed no repair was needed.

agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Recurring benign '.gitconfig: Device or resource busy' warning on container start; earlier in the project it contributed to a max_turns false-failure.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: Document the .gitconfig busy warning as benign; have committer do single-command post-commit validation (worked reliably this session).

overall_notes: Recurring theme across this project: agents hitting max_turns DURING post-work validation produce exit-1 false-failures even though the work landed. Mitigation that worked: give agents a single combined validation command, and when one fails on max_turns mid-validation, verify the working tree from the main session / dispatch a cheap verify-repair pass rather than redoing the work. Also: a fan-out from T3 to T4+T5 parallelized cleanly via run_agent_in_docker_batch (different files). No Alexandria guide updates (no new tool setup). bd: all session beads closed.
